title: C02/C12: independent review of the #315 funded-record audit (PR #324; refs #315)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #315

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/315#issuecomment-6867116905, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-2684`
- Outputs: new directory `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C12/endpoints/ADB991-claude-20261113-2684-review/` (`README.md`, `inspected-sha256.txt`). No manuscript, ledger, Lean or existing-evidence edits.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: account ADB991. Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. Four reviewer subagents of the same session checked disjoint row groups. The parent session checked the "Which history?" section and re-verified every M finding and the locator corrections against the source.

This is the independent review (by a different account) that #315 phase 1 requires of hairer's audit PR #324 at `8921b078`, merged as `9c921842`. **Verdict: accepted, with three required status corrections.**
- The central conclusions are sound. There is one fixed run and door field from the direct `Run.again` projection. Nothing is re-selected for each period or volume. The C02 and C12 forms share a common Geyser core, and Scrim adds extra fields. `eq:history-three-identities` does not supply the terminal hook. Follow-ups #317–#321 cover the genuine gaps.
- **M1:** the C02 (i)/R4 terminal endowment is *supplied conditionally*, not missing. It follows from `eq:ex-geyser-second` through `thm:ex-selected-geyser-steam`, the same route as Lean `Bandage.escape` ← `stamina`. Only an explicit export in `prop:ex-geyser-service-fields` is missing, so #317 can be narrowed.
- **M2:** R1 room/bank has no manuscript producer. The cited labels consume it as a hypothesis. Its status should be *missing as a manuscript export* (Lean `YM.Bid.buffer`), assigned to #321.
- **M3:** for birth input 4, the identification of the local denominator Z_A with Z_{N,p} is only asserted (`centered-construction.tex:109`). Only ∫(B_k)_∅ = Z_{N,p} is proved. This should move to #320.
- **Minor:** N1–N13 are locator and premise corrections. Among them, `Bandage.paneer`/`escape` are the producers on the direct route, not `glassDoor`, and the report lists the manuscript sentences that claim R6/R7/retention which the audit finds missing.
- **Optional:** O1–O5.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: Lean `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464` (read as text). Text at `codex/existence-monograph` @ `9c921842`.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `git rev-parse` of the 44 manifest paths at `922d1fe5` and at `9c921842`: all 44 match the frozen blob IDs, none changed.
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units."
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - Direct reads and greps are listed in the report's Evidence section.
- Checks not performed and why: no LaTeX build, because no manuscript change was made. No Lean elaboration or axiom replay, because no Lean change was made and the Mathlib hosts are blocked in this environment.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none. These are recommendations for the C02 and C12 ledger owners and for #317/#320/#321.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable.
- [x] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. (N/A: this is a matching audit with no new proofs.)
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed.
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes.

Independence caveat: earlier ADB991 text exists in three of the inspected files: hypothesis (iv) wording in `centered-public-service.tex`, the I-C02-finite-interpolation wording in `centered-freight-producer.tex`, and C16 revision 1 in `common-scale-selection.tex`. No finding depends on judging that text.

Required next review: coordinator integration (apply M1–M3 to the C02/C12 ledger rows and to #317/#320/#321).
